snippet.title: Effulgence Game - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The glow of a distant galaxy comes to life in symbols. Defeat creatures to collect crafting particles and use them to print weapons, gear, and mechanisms on a special printer.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3302080/Effulgence/
